features: Music matters: Fire up the music player and enjoy your favourite tunes around the clock with the powerful built-in loudspeaker. Plus, you can tune into FM Radio with or without a headset.
Talk for longer: Talk from sunrise ‘til sundown1 and fill your day with good conversations. The 1450mAh battery delivers hours of talk time, or up to a month of standby.
Ease of use: Big 2.4” display, tactile keymat, balanced design and easy-to-use UI make navigating, the features or texting simple and fast.
Built to last: Each Nokia phone go through rigorous durability tests so you can trust your device to deliver even if the day gets more hectic.
description: From the moment you wake up to when you turn in at night, fill your day with music and conversations. With its big battery and powerful speaker, Nokia 150 lasts long and plays loud. Use the dedicated Music key to jump straight into your favorite tracks and play them around the clock.
